name: Attack on the Tower
summary: At Refuge Pointe, Skuerto sends you to search the ogre-held tower for three items tied to Trelane. The phylactery, orb and ember agate should be in chests inside, and Skuerto says Malin will be pleased when you return with them.

sections.title: Into the Tower
sections.body: After Kryten enchants the gem, Skuerto sends you to find Trelane's phylactery, orb and ember agate. The three items should be in chests inside the tower, ready for you to open. But the ogres are dangerous. The tower's defenses will not deal with them, and the ogres will hurt you if they catch you stealing.

sections.title: Skuerto's Verdict
sections.body: When you return with the three items, Skuerto says Malin could not have asked for a worthier person to help them here. Malin will be delighted to learn their venture has succeeded so completely.

faq.answer: Skuerto sends you from Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands after Kryten enchants the gem.

faq.q: What items are you sent to retrieve?
faq.answer: You are sent to retrieve Trelane's phylactery, orb and ember agate. Each should be in a chest inside the tower.
The tower's defenses will not deal with the ogres. If they catch you stealing, they will hurt you.
It follows An Apprentice's Enchantment, where Kryten enchants the gem and sends you to Skuerto.
